args: m="$(command -v mise 2>/dev/null || echo "$HOME/.local/bin/mise")"; exec "$m" --cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}" exec -- hk mcp --root "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"
m="$(command -v mise 2>/dev/null || echo "$HOME/.local/bin/mise")"; cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}" && exec "$m" exec -- pitchfork mcp --local

m="$(command -v mise 2>/dev/null || echo "$HOME/.local/bin/mise")"; d="$HOME/.cache/mise"; mkdir -p "$d" && t=$(mktemp "$d/usage-mise.XXXXXX") && "$m" usage > "$t" && mv "$t" "$d/usage-mise.kdl" && exec "$m" exec -- usage mcp -f "$d/usage-mise.kdl"
